notes: The provided tile markers give a short route that is as safe as possible to the ladder required for the quest.
The markers additionally indicate when specific other actions should be performed (e.g. swapping protection prayers or right clicking on particular tiles).

steps.text: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem.
chat: 1. Sounds like a quest for me; I can't turn that down!
4. Is there any way into Menaphos from below?

steps.text: Go to the most north-eastern building in Sophanem and talk to Jex.
Climb-down the ladder in the building, then the trapdoor.

Follow the red line on the map to the ladder and/or use the provided tile markers for guidance. Protection from magic is recommended. It is also recommended to turn off auto-retaliate in the combat tab.
You will encounter one scarab trap via this path. BE HIGHLY CAUTIOUS as triggering it would drop you to a multi combat lower level.
Green markers indicate the correct direction to travel when the path forks.
Yellow markers indicate the correct tiles to stand on carefully, when dealing with traps or other threats.
Red markers contain other warnings.
Search Kaleef's body.
Read the parchment.
Talk to Maisa to the west.
Speak to Osman in front of the Al Kharid palace.
chat: 2. I want to talk to you about Sophanem
3. It would drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.

steps.text: Travel to Sophanem and speak to Osman again outside the gates.
chat: 3. I know of a secret entrance to the north.

steps.text: Navigate the tunnels to the ladder again.
Kill the level 191 Giant scarab.

If you decide to mage the Giant Scarab, it can be safespotted by standing near Kaleef's body, use Protect from Missiles. Note: The Giant Scarab can still spawn mages and riders that can attack you which you should be highly careful of. The Giant Scarab CAN extinguish bullseye lanterns; bring a tinderbox.
Talk to Osman.
Pick up Keris if you wish (needed for Desert hard diary).
(Tip: Do not teleport out if you wish to complete a task for Desert hard diary, instead return to the maze and kill a Locust rider with the Keris.)
Return to Sophanem and talk to the High Priest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
